description: Use this when a PR diff adds a require line in go.mod, when justifying a new external dep, or when responding to an sdk-dep-vet-devil verdict. Covers the license/CVE/maintenance/size gate: govulncheck, osv-scanner, license allowlist, transitive count, last-commit-age, and the dependencies.md provenance contract that backs guardrails G31–G34. Triggers: go get, dependency, govulncheck, osv-scanner, license, supply chain, new dep, go.mod, DD-, CVE.
